description: This file defines the ListenerBus trait used in Apache Spark for managing event listeners, posting events, and handling listener lifecycle and exceptions.

classes.name: ListenerBus
classes.description: A trait for an event bus that posts events to registered listeners, manages listener lifecycle, and handles event posting with timing and exception handling.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Returns an optional Timer for measuring event processing time, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the bus in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a specific listener from the bus.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all listeners from the bus.

methods.name: removeListenerOnError
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a listener causes an error; can be overridden.

methods.name: postToAll
methods.description: Posts an event to all registered listeners, timing the processing and handling exceptions.

methods.name: doPostEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to post an event to a specific listener, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isIgnorableException
methods.description: Determines if an exception can be ignored; default is false.

methods.name: findListenersByClass
methods.description: Finds listeners of a specific class type.

methods.name: redactEvent
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from events, specifically SparkListenerEnvironmentUpdate events.
